I can do a phone interview if that's an option, or I can accept a short take-home coding exercise and upload the results within 3 hours.

I apologize for the day-of notice — happy to be flexible. My phone number is +1 415-555-0193.

— Liam

Sean / Mateo — forwarding Liam's note (below). He's reporting a building-wide outage and may not have stable video. He offered a phone interview (gave his number) or to do a short take-home coding exercise and upload within a few hours.

Options I'm considering:
- Keep the 10:00 slot and switch to a phone screen (Mina does 30m technical by phone, Mateo 30m phone if desired)
- Convert to a 30m phone + send take-home for follow-up asynchronous work
- Cancel and reschedule if the team prefers live video only

Can you reply with which you prefer? Mina, can you confirm whether you can do phone-only at 10:00?

Thanks,
Monica

Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate power outage — phone or take-home?

Thanks for the flag, Monica. Given this is a day-of outage and the candidate proactively offered alternatives, my preference is to keep the process moving. Proposed plan:

1) 10:00 AM PT slot becomes a phone-first interview. Mina will run the 30m technical phone screen.
2) Immediately after, we send a brief take-home (30–45 minutes suggested) that Liam can complete and upload within 3 hours — we'll use that for any code review follow-up.
3) If the candidate's battery dies mid-call, we accept a voicemail summary and rely on the take-home.

Mina, are you able to take the 10:00 phone screen? Mateo, if you want to keep 30m for hiring-manager questions we can do that back-to-back by phone as well — otherwise we can review take-home results asynchronously.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference

I can take the 10:00 phone screen. I'll call Liam at +1 415-555-0193 and run through the standard 30m technical plan. If we have time, Mateo can hop on for the HM portion; if not, I'll send my notes and we can review the take-home. Please send the phone invite and the take-home doc link.

I've attached the calendar phone invite (20270519-phone-interview.ics) and the take-home instructions (takehome-instructions.pdf) — the take-home is optional but appreciated if you can complete it within 3 hours of receiving it. Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/takehome-123

Phone invite attached. Please reply to confirm you received this and that the number is still correct.
